candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is a composite of three elements: synchysis scintillans, morning glory disc anomaly, and chronic retinal detachment. C001 names only the retinal detachment component and even then specifies 'peripapillary' rather than the broader chronic retinal detachment described. The defining diagnostic feature—synchysis scintillans (iridescent needle-like cholesterol crystals freely floating in the aqueous)—and the morning glory disc anomaly are entirely absent.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures only the chronic retinal detachment component; omits synchysis scintillans (the primary anterior-segment finding of cholesterol crystals in the aqueous) and the morning glory disc anomaly

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis is a composite triple entity; single-component candidates will inherently be partial
Synchysis scintillans is the primary novel/leading diagnosis; retinal detachment and morning glory disc are associated structural findings
